name: ZCA_USER_ACTION_TRACKING
description: This table stores telemetry data Capturing what Smart Action was performed when by which user.

columns.name: USER_ACTION_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of User who invoked smart action, USER_ID of table per_users.

columns.name: USER_ACTION_NAME
columns.description: User action name, same with zca_user_action.USER_ACTION_NAME.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Entity Name, Same style with zca_user_action.Entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_PRIMARY_KEY_VALUE
columns.description: The primary key value of Entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_STATE_VARIABLES
columns.description: JSON format String to store Entity state variables name and value.

columns.name: USER_ACTION_APPLICATION
columns.description: Application Name, such as ORACLE-Workspace-APP or ORACLE-ISS-APP.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_REFERENCE
columns.description: value of  process action rest call response header X-ORACLE-DMS-ECID

columns.name: DRIVING_ATTRIBUTES_VALUE
columns.description: Transaction object driving attributes and values in JSON Array format for smart action boosting.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
